name: hue-board
description: Offline Scriptable Hue controller and bundled React control deck

scripts.test: node frontend/build.cjs && node build.cjs && node --test tests/*.test.cjs
scripts.test:timing: node frontend/build.cjs && node build.cjs && node tests/timing.cjs
scripts.demo: node frontend/build.cjs && node build.cjs && node tests/make-demo.cjs && node tests/make-layout-demo.cjs
scripts.test:ui: node frontend/build.cjs && node build.cjs && node tests/make-demo.cjs && node tests/make-layout-demo.cjs && python tests/react_ui_qa.py
scripts.test:e2e: node frontend/build.cjs && node build.cjs && python tests/react_controller_e2e.py
scripts.test:ui:everyday: node frontend/build.cjs && node build.cjs && node tests/everyday_host.cjs --demo && python tests/v5_ui_qa.py
scripts.test:e2e:everyday: node frontend/build.cjs && node build.cjs && node tests/everyday_host.cjs --demo && python tests/v5_controller_e2e.py
scripts.check: corepack pnpm verify:release && corepack pnpm build && corepack pnpm export:ios-contract && corepack pnpm typecheck && corepack pnpm test && corepack pnpm test:timing
scripts.test:release-candidate: corepack pnpm test && corepack pnpm test:timing && corepack pnpm test:ui && corepack pnpm test:e2e && corepack pnpm test:ui:everyday && corepack pnpm test:e2e:everyday
